$ lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN | awk '$9 ~ /:[89][0-9]{3}$/'                     
  lsof lists listening TCP sockets without resolving names; awk keeps the rows  
  whose address ends in a port from 8000-9999.
